A subtle detail, yet a defining element of Argo’s sophisticated character. @media all and (max-width: 767px) { .et-banner-6ae6e83a56a69.et-banner { height: 50vh !important;} } . watches.name: ARGOMATIC – AM06
watches.description: Featuring a Miyota 9015 movement, sapphire crystal, and a 316L stainless steel case. Precise finishes and engraved details make each watch a tribute to narrative design. SPECIFICATIONS CASE: 316L Stainless Steel Sandblasted CASE COLOR: Gold Champagne DIAMETER: 42 mm THICKNESS: 10,7 mm WEIGHT: 130 gr CRYSTAL: Flat Sapphire with A/R Coating HANDS: Aluminum Diamond Cut DIAL: Double Layered with Date at 6′ DIAL COLOR: Deep Blue LUMINESCENCE: Super-LumiNova BGW9® MOVEMENT: Automatic Miyota 9015 POWER RESERVE: 42 Hours CASEBACK: Flat Sapphire WRISTBAND: 316L Stainless Steel Full Link WATER RESISTANT: 5 ATM/50 Meters CONCEPT @media all and (max-width: 767px) { .et-banner-6ae6e83a85939.et-banner { height: 50vh !important;} } . INSPIRED BY A SEXTANT A bright red hand is reminiscent of the lens on old sextants, while engravings on each quarter of the dial recall their graduated arc. Precision finishes and engraved details make each one a tribute to engineering and narrative design. @media all and (max-width: 767px) { .et-banner-6ae6e83a868a5.et-banner { height: 50vh !important;} } . THE CASE SHAPE We wanted to create a case shape that would make Argomatic unique. To do so, we draw inspiration from the Argo ship, and tapered the two sides of the case to mimic its hull shape. The sandblasting lends it strength and the lack of lugs gives the 42 mm diamete r a size suitable even for smaller wrists. Moreover, due to its 10.7 mm thickness , Argomatic will also be extremely light on your wrist. @media all and (max-width: 767px) { .et-banner-6ae6e83a878f9.et-banner { height: 50vh !important;} } . LUMINESCENCE As for the day, even in the dark we wanted to give ArgoMatic its uniqueness. The BGW9 pigment with its intensity and the points on the dial on which it has been applied, gives a starry sky effect when looking at Argomatic in the dark. @media all and (max-width: 767px) { .et-banner-6ae6e83a88a16.et-banner { height: 50vh !important;} } . MOVEMENT Powered by the renowned Miyota 9015 automatic movement, this timepiece combines Japanese precision with exceptional reliability. Operating at 28,800 vibrations per hour (4 Hz) , it features 24 jewels , a 42-hour power reserve , automatic and manual winding , and a hacking seconds function for precise time setting. Its slim construction enables refined case proportions, making the 9015 a trusted choice for premium mechanical watches.

watches.name: FOCUSCOPE – Blue Cosmo
watches.description: @media all and (max-width: 767px) { .et-banner-6ae6e83a907e2.et-banner { height: 50vh !important;} } . INSPIRED BY GALILEO’S TELESCOPE The dial features an intricate design that hints at the details of Galilei’s telescope, with the Roman numerals and hands blending harmoniously with the dial finishes. The combination of copper, steel, and meteorite in the 5 dial layers construction adds an element of charm and uniqueness. The brushed, polished and sandblasted finishes create a three-dimensional structure that catches the light differently, depending on the angle. @media all and (max-width: 767px) { .et-banner-6ae6e83a91a91.et-banner { height: 50vh !important;} } . AN OUT OF THIS WORLD DESIGN…AND MATERIALS The Muonionalusta Meteorite, one of Scandinavia’s oldest discoveries, brings cosmic mystery to your wrist. Formed 4.5 billion years ago, its natural Widmanstätten crystalline patterns create a unique texture on every single dial. @media all and (max-width: 767px) { .et-banner-6ae6e83a92abb.et-banner { height: 50vh !important;} } . DISTINCTIVE CASE Crafted from solid 316L steel, the case boasts a sleek 40mm diameter and 11.2mm thickness, creating an elegant yet striking wrist presence. Semi-concealed lugs ensure a smooth transition to the strap. The side engravings are not mere decorations but an artistic tribute to the dial’s intricate layers within. @media all and (max-width: 767px) { .et-banner-6ae6e83a93b25.et-banner { height: 50vh !important;} } . A MESMERIZING LUMINOVA The 6 layers of Super-LumiNova BGW9 beneath the sapphire crystal, creates a captivating depth effect. This brilliance shines in the darkest hours, ensuring exceptional visibility in any scenario. @media all and (max-width: 767px) { .et-banner-6ae6e83a94a21.et-banner { height: 50vh !important;} } . MOVEMENT At the heart of this timepiece beats the Miyota 9039 , a premium Japanese automatic movement renowned for its reliability, precision, and refined engineering. Operating at a high frequency of 28,800 vibrations per hour (4 Hz) , it delivers a smooth sweeping seconds hand while ensuring excellent timekeeping performance.
